note: AUTH-OPERATIONS-011: machine-readable mirror of docs/07 section 15.6's release-signoff checklist. Never edit an item's description here without updating the matching markdown checkbox in docs/07 (and vice versa) -- scripts/validate-release-checklist.mjs fails CI the moment the two diverge, in either direction. Filling in status/evidence for a real release is an operator's job; nothing in this repository or its CI can set status to "verified" on its own -- see AUTH-OPERATIONS-011's own canonical requirement text: production readiness must be an explicit machine-readable evidence checklist, 'never a certification or automatic security claim.' A status of "verified" with no evidence, or evidence that is empty/placeholder text, fails validation just as hard as a stale item list does.
